versionNote: LangChain 0.3+/1.x — partner chats live in langchain-<vendor>; init_chat_model is the stable entry point.

snippets.title: Provider-agnostic chat
snippets.code:
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

model = init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini")
print(model.invoke("Reply in one sentence: what is LCEL?").content)

snippets.title: JS ChatOpenAI

migrationNotes: Do not import ChatOpenAI from langchain.chat_models — use langchain_openai or init_chat_model.
Replace llm.predict() / llm() string calls with model.invoke(messages).

versionNote: LCEL (pipe operator) is the supported way to compose prompts, models, and parsers.

snippets.title: prompt | model | parser
snippets.code:
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
    ("system", "Be terse."),
    ("human", "{question}"),
])
chain = prompt | init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini") | StrOutputParser()
print(chain.invoke({"question": "What is a Runnable?"}))

migrationNotes: LLMChain, SimpleSequentialChain, and ConversationChain should be rewritten as LCEL pipes.
Use chain.stream() for tokens; chain.batch() for fan-out.

versionNote: Prefer create_agent or LangGraph create_react_agent. initialize_agent is gone.

snippets.title: Tool-calling agent
snippets.code:
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain_core.tools import tool
from langchain.chat_models import init_chat_model

@tool
def multiply(a: float, b: float) -> float:
    """Multiply two numbers."""
    return a * b

agent = create_agent(init_chat_model("openai:gpt-4.1-mini"), tools=[multiply])
print(agent.invoke({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "12 * 7"}]}))

migrationNotes: initialize_agent(..., AgentType.ZERO_SHOT_REACT_DESCRIPTION) → create_agent / create_react_agent.
AgentExecutor remains only as a compatibility shim; do not start new code on it.

versionNote: Build RAG with a retriever + create_retrieval_chain, not RetrievalQA.

snippets.title: Minimal RAG
snippets.code:
from langchain_core.documents import Document
from langchain_core.vectorstores import InMemoryVectorStore
from langchain_openai import OpenAIEmbeddings, ChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate
from langchain.chains.combine_documents import create_stuff_documents_chain
from langchain.chains import create_retrieval_chain

docs = [Document(page_content="LCEL composes Runnables with |")]
vs = InMemoryVectorStore.from_documents(docs, OpenAIEmbeddings())
prompt = ChatPromptTemplate.from_template("Context:{context}\nQ:{input}")
combine = create_stuff_documents_chain(ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini"), prompt)
rag = create_retrieval_chain(vs.as_retriever(), combine)
print(rag.invoke({"input": "What is LCEL?"})["answer"])

migrationNotes: RetrievalQA.from_chain_type(...) is deprecated.
ConversationalRetrievalChain → history-aware retriever + LCEL, or a LangGraph node.

versionNote: LlamaIndex 0.10+ / 0.12+: llama_index.core + VectorStoreIndex. ServiceContext is removed.
imports: from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader, Settings, Document

snippets.title: Index + query engine
snippets.code:
from llama_index.core import VectorStoreIndex, SimpleDirectoryReader, Settings
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI
from llama_index.embeddings.openai import OpenAIEmbedding

Settings.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini")
Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")
docs = SimpleDirectoryReader("./data").load_data()
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents(docs)
print(index.as_query_engine().query("What changed in the latest release?"))

migrationNotes: GPTSimpleVectorIndex / GPTVectorStoreIndex → VectorStoreIndex.
Do not pass service_context=; assign Settings.llm / Settings.embed_model.

snippets.title: Local LlamaIndex + Ollama
snippets.code:
from llama_index.core import Settings, VectorStoreIndex, Document
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.ollama import OllamaEmbedding

Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.2", request_timeout=120.0)
Settings.embed_model = OllamaEmbedding(model_name="nomic-embed-text")
index = VectorStoreIndex.from_documents([Document(text="Ollama serves local models.")])
print(index.as_query_engine().query("What does Ollama serve?"))

migrationNotes: pip install llama-index-llms-ollama llama-index-embeddings-ollama
Pull models first: ollama pull llama3.2 && ollama pull nomic-embed-text

versionNote: FunctionAgent / ReActAgent from llama_index.core.agent.workflow in current releases.

snippets.title: FunctionAgent
snippets.code:
from llama_index.core.agent.workflow import FunctionAgent
from llama_index.llms.openai import OpenAI

async def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Add two integers."""
    return a + b

agent = FunctionAgent(tools=[add], llm=OpenAI(model="gpt-4.1-mini"))
print(await agent.run("What is 21 + 21?"))

migrationNotes: OpenAIAgent / ReActAgent constructors from older llama_index.agent paths moved under core.agent.workflow.
Query-engine-as-tool still works via QueryEngineTool.from_defaults(query_engine).

versionNote: Ollama current REST: /api/chat for messages, /api/generate for one-shot prompts. OpenAI-compatible /v1 is supported.

snippets.title: Python chat

import ollama
r = ollama.chat(model="llama3.2", messages=[
    {"role": "user", "content": "Write a haiku about local LLMs"},
])
print(r["message"]["content"])

migrationNotes: Tool calling quality depends on the model (llama3.1+/qwen2.5/etc.).
Stream with stream=True and iterate chunks; final tool_calls appear on the assembled message.
